buildingZones.name: Rynek i Stare Miasto
buildingZones.notes: 18th–19th c. Silesian townhouses with ground-floor shopfronts, warm pastel/ochre plaster, occasional exposed red/yellow brick & Secession gables, pitched red clay tile roofs.

buildingZones.name: Osiedle Mickiewicza, Grunwaldzkie, Kopernika & Przy Plantach
buildingZones.notes: Thermomodernized Polish PRL wielka płyta apartment slabs with cream/peach/cool-grey plaster, rhythmic horizontal balcony bands, and flat roofs with lift/ventilation penthouses.

buildingZones.name: Zabudowa Ceglana (Bazylika, Kościół Ewangelicki, PKP, Szkoły)
buildingZones.notes: 19th-century Prussian/Silesian red facing brick (licówka) civic, church, railway station, and school architecture with dark slate spires and gabled clay tile roofs.

buildingZones.name: Centra Handlowe (Auchan DK44, Kaufland/DL Shopping, Galeria PIK)
buildingZones.notes: Low-rise retail boxes and strip malls with neutral metal/plaster cladding, wide parking forecourts, and bright red/crimson/terracotta fascia bands.

buildingZones.name: Strefa Przemysłowa (Carboautomatyka, Yazaki, FPM, Towarowa)
buildingZones.notes: Silesian manufacturing halls and logistics warehouses along ul. Towarowa, Fabryczna, Wyzwolenia, and the Katowice–Rybnik railway siding.

buildingZones.name: Zabudowa Jednorodzinna (Kamionka, Gronie, Reta, Wymyślanka, Podlesie)
buildingZones.notes: Detached 2-story Polish suburban single-family houses (domki jednorodzinne) with pastel/cream plaster facades, steep terracotta/brown/anthracite tiled roofs, and hedged gardens on rolling Silesian hills.

streetViewNotes.topography: Mikołów sits on the rolling Upper Silesian Uplands (Wyżyna Śląska). Real EU-DEM 25m elevations span 279.68 m ASL (northern Jamna/Potok valley) to 337.53 m ASL (SE Kamionka/Gronie ridge) — 57.84 m of authentic vertical relief. Historic Rynek rests at 289.49 m ASL (~9.8 m normalized), climbing eastward toward Bazylika św. Wojciecha and southward/southeastward into the Kamionka/Gronie hills.

facadePalettes.rynekAndOldTown: Subdued historic Silesian pastels (warm cream, ochre, écru, muted terracotta, pale beige) with darker ground-floor shopfronts and exposed red/yellow brick on Secession/late-19th c. townhouses (e.g., Rynek 4, ul. Jana Pawła II).
facadePalettes.churchesAndStation: Exposed 19th-century Prussian/Silesian red facing brick (licówka) on neo-Romanesque Bazylika św. Wojciecha (twin towers with dark slate pyramidal spires), neo-Gothic Kościół Ewangelicki św. Jana (tall single needle spire on castle hill), and 1856 Dworzec PKP Mikołów.
facadePalettes.prlEstates: Renovated 4–5 story wielka płyta apartment blocks on Osiedle Mickiewicza, Osiedle Grunwaldzkie, Osiedle Kopernika, and Osiedle przy Plantach: warm cream, pastel peach/apricot, and light grey plaster with horizontal concrete balcony stripes and flat roofs.
facadePalettes.suburbanDomki: 2-story detached Polish single-family homes (domki) in cream, sand, and light warm plaster with steep pitched red-terracotta, dark brown, or anthracite tiled roofs.
facadePalettes.retailAndIndustrial: Clean white/light-grey cladding with crimson/blue retail fascias (Auchan, Kaufland, Galeria PIK, MOSiR) and steel-grey industrial warehouses along ul. Towarowa / Fabryczna / Wyzwolenia.

roofTypes.kamienica: Pitched gabled/mansard terracotta & crimson clay tile roofs (dachówka karpiówka/zakładkowa) with varied ridge heights and dormers.
roofTypes.blok: Flat concrete/tar-felt roofs with recessed rooftop elevator shafts and vent penthouses.
roofTypes.domek: Steep gabled/hipped red clay, brown, or charcoal tile roofs.
roofTypes.churches: Dark slate/copper-patina spires and high pitched naves.

sidewalkWidthsM.rynekPromenade: 3.2–4.0 m wide granite/cobblestone promenades and wide pedestrian frontages around Rynek & Plac Synagogi.
sidewalkWidthsM.oldTownLanes: 2.4–3.0 m paved sidewalks along ul. św. Wojciecha, ul. Stefana Okrzei, ul. Górnicza.
sidewalkWidthsM.mainAvenues: 2.5–3.2 m modernized concrete/paver sidewalks & shared bike-pedestrian paths along ul. Konstytucji 3 Maja, ul. Krakowska, ul. Katowicka, ul. Karola Miarki, ul. Prusa.
sidewalkWidthsM.residentialStreets: 1.8–2.2 m standard concrete block (kostka brukowa) sidewalks along residential & estate roads.
sidewalkWidthsM.highways: 0.8–1.0 m asphalt/gravel shoulders along DK44 (ul. Cieszyńska) and DK81 (ul. Beskidzka).

greenSpaceAndTrees.parks: Park Duże Planty (0.72 density) and Małe Planty (0.65 density) feature dense mature deciduous canopies (linden, maple, oak, horse chestnut) lining winding park paths and the Aleksander stream.
greenSpaceAndTrees.forests: Kamionka/Gronie (SE), Jamna/Reta (N/NW), and Podlesie (E) woods feature dense mixed Silesian forest (0.85–0.90 density: beech, oak, birch, Scots pine).
greenSpaceAndTrees.sportsAndLawns: MOSiR Planty outdoor pool/fields, Stadion AKS Mikołów, and Orlik have open manicured turf (0.06–0.15 perimeter trees).
greenSpaceAndTrees.cemeteriesAndAllotments: Cmentarz Parafialny, Cmentarz Ewangelicki, Stary Cmentarz Żydowski, ROD Magnolia, and ROD Kolejarz carry medium tree cover (0.42–0.58 density).
